Share your referral link with friends. When they install Pyllar, complete setup, start a daily SIP, and earn the 7-day streak badge, both of you receive 100 coins.
Does my friend need to enter a referral code?
No. Your referral code is automatically attached to the shared link, so your friend just needs to install the app using your link.
Your friend earns the 7-day streak badge after completing investments for 7 days in a row. If they pause, cancel, or miss an investment, the streak resets and starts over.
When do we receive our referral rewards?
Both you and your friend receive 100 coins once your friend earns the 7-day streak badge.
How do I use or withdraw my coins?
Coins are added to your Pyllar wallet. 100 coins = ₹100, and they can be redeemed according to wallet redemption rules.
Is there a limit to how many friends I can invite?
No. You can invite as many friends as you want and earn rewards for each eligible referral.

KYC (Know Your Customer) is mandatory as per SEBI and government regulations.
To complete your KYC, we'll ask for:
We start by verifying your PAN. When asked, please enter your name and date of birth exactly as mentioned on your PAN card.
Any mismatch may lead to verification failure.
We need a few additional details, such as:
Enter your bank account number and IFSC. This account will be used to deduct SIP installments and credit any withdrawals.
Please ensure the account is in your name and UPI-enabled.
This step is required only if your KYC is not already completed with a SEBI-registered entity.
Your Aadhaar details will be securely fetched from DigiLocker and used for identity verification and Aadhaar e-Sign.
For KYC verification issues, tap 'KYC Verification' below to chat with our support team on WhatsApp.
We need your bank account details to:
• Credit your withdrawals directly to you
• Verify your identity as required by regulations
• An individual savings account in your name only
• Not a joint account or account held with others
• Active and have a UPI app linked to it
Make sure these details are accurate. Any error will cause verification to fail.
Select how much you want to invest regularly through your SIP.

• We'll ask you to verify your bank account
• You'll make a refundable ₹1 payment through your UPI app
• The ₹1 will be refunded to your account within 2-3 business days
